title: VinaMetal
description: VinaMetal is a fork of AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 that integrates AutoDock 4 metal coordination physics into the native scoring function: metal-specific 12-6 van der Waals terms, a differentiable coordination-number penalty and a bounded geometry bonus, all with analytic gradients. It detects coordination sites already occupied by the rigid receptor and adjusts the ligand coordination-number target automatically. Redocking of GlfT2 (Mn2+) and PDB 1s63 (Zn2+) reproduced the crystal binding modes with heavy-atom RMSDs of 0.95 A and 0.33 A.
